records.literal_gloss: Of David. I will give you thanks with all my heart; before [the] gods I will sing praises to you.

en.L: Of David. I will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks with all my heart; before [the] gods I will sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: Of David. With all my heart I will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks; in the presence of the gods I will make music for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: By David. I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all my heart. I will sing praise to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in front of the gods.

fr.L: De David. Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce de tout mon cœur ; devant les dieux je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} chanterai des louanges.
fr.B: De David. De tout mon cœur je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce ; en présence des dieux je jouerai de la musique pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: De David. Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierai de tout mon cœur. Je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} louanges devant les dieux.

sw.L: Ya Daudi. Nitakushukuru kwa moyo wangu wote; mbele ya miungu nitakuimbia sifa.
sw.B: Ya Daudi. Kwa moyo wangu wote nitakushukuru; mbele ya miungu nitakupigia muziki.
sw.R: Ya Daudi. Nitakushukuru kwa moyo wangu wote. Nitakuimbia sifa mbele ya miungu.

es.L: De David. Te daré gracias con todo mi corazón; delante de los dioses {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cantaré alabanzas.
es.B: De David. Con todo mi corazón {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias; en presencia de los dioses {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cantaré salmos.
es.R: De David. Te daré gracias con todo mi corazón. Te cantaré alabanzas delante de los dioses.

vi.L: Của Đa-vít. Tôi sẽ hết lòng cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; trước mặt các thần, tôi sẽ hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Của Đa-vít. Tôi sẽ hết lòng cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; trước mặt các thần, tôi sẽ đàn hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Của Đa-vít. Tôi sẽ hết lòng cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi sẽ hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước mặt các thần.

ko.L: 다윗의 [노래]. 제가 온 마음으로 주님께 감사드리겠습니다. 신들 앞에서 제가 주님을 노래로 찬양하겠습니다.
ko.B: 다윗의 노래. 제가 온 마음을 다해 주님께 감사드리겠습니다. 신들 앞에서 주님께 노래하며 연주하겠습니다.
ko.R: 다윗의 노래. 제가 온 마음으로 주님께 감사드리겠습니다. 신들 앞에서 주님을 찬양하는 노래를 부르겠습니다.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the last psalms of David
decisions.reason: Psalms 138-145 are the last group of psalms in the book that carry David's name.

decisions.choice: before the gods: in the face of the gods the nations worship
alternatives: before the angels (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The word ('elohim) can mean God, gods, or heavenly beings. Here it is plural: the singer praises the LORD openly, in defiance of the gods of the nations (verse 4 speaks of their kings). The ancient Greek translation reads "before the angels".

decisions.choice: I will give you thanks: no name in the Hebrew text
alternatives: I will give you thanks, LORD
decisions.reason: Some Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient Greek translation add "LORD" after the first verb. The text here does not have it; the LORD is named in verse 4.

decisions.choice: With all my heart first (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the phrase first for emphasis; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: The psalmist speaks to God in the second person singular, with "wewe" and its forms ("nitakushukuru", "kwako") as free pronouns under the deity_pronoun setting
decisions.reason: Swahili prayer speaks to God as "wewe", as these psalms do throughout; the verb forms carry "you" inside them, so the setting appears only on the free pronouns and possessives ("yako", "lako", "wewe").

decisions.choice: "các thần" in lowercase for the gods
decisions.reason: The gods are those the nations worship (see the meaning decision); "các thần" in lowercase keeps them apart from God, as in Psalm 135:5.

decisions.choice: The Hebrew "you" is "주님", in 합쇼체 with "저", through the psalm
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names no one in this verse (meaning decision); Korean cannot say "you" to God without a title, and "주님" is that title of address, not the divine name, so it carries no span.

source.text: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־הֵיכַ֪ל קָדְשְׁךָ֡ וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל־כָּל־שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: I will bow down toward [the] temple of your holiness and give thanks to your name for your loyal love and for your faithfulness, for you have made great above all your name your word.

en.L: I will bow down toward {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple and give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love and for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word great above all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.
en.B: I will bow down facing {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple and praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness; for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise great, beyond all that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name had made known.
en.R: I will bow down toward {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple. I will praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love and because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} always do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say. What {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} promised and did is even greater than everything people knew about {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Je me prosternerai vers le temple de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sainteté et je rendrai grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal et pour {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rendu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole grande au-dessus de tout {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.B: Je me prosternerai, tourné vers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint temple, et je louerai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité ; car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rendu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse plus grande que tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom avait fait connaître.
fr.R: Je me prosternerai vers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint temple. Je louerai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle et parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais toujours ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis. Ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as promis et accompli est encore plus grand que tout ce que l’on savait de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Nitasujudu kuelekea hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu na kulishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa ajili ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kwa ajili ya uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kwa maana umelikuza neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} juu ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lote.
sw.B: Nitasujudu nikilielekea hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu na kulisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; kwa maana umeikuza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kupita yote ambayo jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lilikuwa limejulisha.
sw.R: Nitasujudu nikilielekea hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu. Nitalisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa sababu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, na kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutenda kila unachosema daima. Ulichoahidi na kukifanya ni kikubwa kuliko yote ambayo watu walijua kuhusu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.

es.L: Me postraré hacia {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo templo y daré gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal y por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has engrandecido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra por encima de todo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre.
es.B: Me postraré mirando hacia {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo templo y alabaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad; porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has engrandecido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} promesa, más allá de todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre había dado a conocer.
es.R: Me postraré hacia {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo templo. Alabaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel y porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} siempre haces lo que dices. Lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} prometiste e hiciste es aún más grande que todo lo que la gente sabía de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ cúi lạy hướng về đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và cảm tạ danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vì sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn cao hơn cả danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ cúi lạy hướng về đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì tình yêu thương thành tín và sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lớn lao, vượt trên mọi điều danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tỏ ra.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ cúi lạy hướng về đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi sẽ ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nói. Những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa và đã làm còn lớn hơn mọi điều người ta biết về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제가 주님의 거룩한 성전을 향하여 엎드리고, 주님의 한결같은 사랑과 주님의 신실하심으로 인하여 주님의 이름에 감사드리겠습니다. 주님께서 주님의 말씀을 주님의 모든 이름 위에 크게 하셨기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 제가 주님의 거룩한 성전을 향하여 엎드려, 주님의 한결같은 사랑과 신실하심으로 인하여 주님의 이름을 찬양하겠습니다. 주님께서는 주님의 약속을, 주님의 이름이 알려 준 모든 것보다 더 크게 이루셨습니다.
ko.R: 제가 주님의 거룩한 성전을 향하여 엎드리겠습니다. 주님의 변함없는 사랑 때문에, 그리고 주님께서 말씀하신 것을 언제나 지키시기 때문에 주님의 이름을 찬양하겠습니다. 주님께서 약속하시고 이루신 일은 사람들이 주님에 대해 알던 모든 것보다 더 큽니다.

decisions.choice: bow toward your holy temple: as in 5:8
decisions.reason: Psalm 5:8 has the same words. Worshipers bowed toward the temple, even from far away (1 Kings 8:29-30, 35).

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here the LORD's love for his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: faithfulness: being true and reliable
decisions.reason: The word ('emet) is firmness, truth, being reliable. With loyal love it describes God's character (Exodus 34:6).

decisions.choice: you have made your word great above all your name: the promise kept surpasses all that was known of God
alternatives: you have exalted your name and your word above all things
you have made your name and your word great above everything
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "you have made great, above all your name, your word". Taken as it stands, God's word (his promise, now kept) has gone beyond all that his name had stood for until then. Many read it, with a small change, as "you have exalted your name and your word above all things".

decisions.choice: your word: your promise
decisions.reason: The word ('imrah) is a saying or word, often a promise (119:38).

decisions.choice: because you always do what you say
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's faithfulness is (m3).

decisions.choice: promise
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "promise", what God's word is here (m5).

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" for loyal love and "sự thành tín" for faithfulness, side by side
decisions.reason: The two key terms stand together; the terms note gives "sự thành tín" for faithfulness, and the shared word "thành tín" shows that the two belong together, as loyal love and faithfulness do in Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "신실하심" for faithfulness (L, B); Readable says it as "말씀하신 것을 언제나 지키시다"
decisions.reason: As the terms note (ʾemet: 신실하심); Readable explains the word, as the English Readable does.

source.text: בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי בְנַפְשִׁ֣י עֹֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: On [the] day I called, and you answered me; you made me bold in my soul [with] strength.

en.L: On the day I called, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered me; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made me bold [with] strength in my soul.
en.B: The day I called, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered me; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} filled me with courage and strength within.
en.R: When I called out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered me. You made me brave and strong inside.

fr.L: Le jour où j’ai crié, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as répondu ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as rendu hardi, [avec] de la force dans mon âme.
fr.B: Le jour où j’ai crié, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as répondu ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as rempli de courage et de force au-dedans.
fr.R: Quand je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai appelé, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as répondu. Tu m’as rendu courageux et fort à l’intérieur.

sw.L: Siku niliyoita, ulinijibu; ulinitia ujasiri [kwa] nguvu katika nafsi yangu.
sw.B: Siku ile nilipoita, ulinijibu; ulinijaza ujasiri na nguvu ndani yangu.
sw.R: Nilipokulilia, ulinijibu. Ulinifanya jasiri na mwenye nguvu moyoni.

es.L: El día en que clamé, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me respondiste; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me infundiste valor [con] fuerza en mi alma.
es.B: El día en que clamé, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me respondiste; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me llenaste de valor y de fuerza por dentro.
es.R: Cuando clamé a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me respondiste. Me hiciste valiente y fuerte por dentro.

vi.L: Trong ngày tôi kêu cầu, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đáp lời tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho tôi mạnh dạn [bằng] sức lực trong linh hồn tôi.
vi.B: Ngày tôi kêu cầu, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đáp lời tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tôi lòng can đảm và sức mạnh bên trong.
vi.R: Khi tôi kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trả lời tôi. Ngài làm cho tôi can đảm và mạnh mẽ trong lòng.

ko.L: 제가 부르짖은 날에 주님께서 제게 응답하셨고, 제 영혼에 힘을 주어 저를 담대하게 하셨습니다.
ko.B: 제가 부르짖던 날, 주님께서 응답하셨고, 제 속에 용기와 힘을 가득 채워 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 제가 주님께 부르짖었을 때 주님께서 대답해 주셨습니다. 주님께서는 제 마음을 용감하고 강하게 해 주셨습니다.

decisions.choice: made me bold: gave me courage
decisions.reason: The verb (rahav, causative) is rare. It seems to mean to make someone bold or confident, here with new strength.

decisions.choice: in my soul: within me
decisions.reason: The soul (nefesh) is the whole inner person: the strength is courage, not muscle.

decisions.choice: within (B); inside (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "within" or "inside" for nefesh here (m2).

source.text: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: They will give you thanks, YHWH, all [the] kings of [the] earth, for they have heard [the] words of your mouth.

en.L: All the kings of the earth will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for they have heard the words of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mouth.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, every king on earth will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks, because they have heard the words {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} spoke.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, every king in the world will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} after hearing the words {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken.

fr.L: Tous les rois de la terre {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendront grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car ils ont entendu les paroles de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bouche.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tous les rois de la terre {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendront grâce, parce qu’ils ont entendu les paroles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcées.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tous les rois du monde {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercieront quand ils auront entendu les paroles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dites.

sw.L: Wafalme wote wa dunia watakushukuru, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana wameyasikia maneno ya kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kila mfalme duniani atakushukuru, kwa sababu wameyasikia maneno uliyoyasema.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kila mfalme ulimwenguni atakushukuru baada ya kuyasikia maneno uliyoyasema.

es.L: Todos los reyes de la tierra {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darán gracias, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque han oído las palabras de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} boca.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, todos los reyes de la tierra {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darán gracias, porque han oído las palabras que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dijiste.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, todos los reyes del mundo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darán gracias después de oír las palabras que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has dicho.

vi.L: Hết thảy các vua trên đất sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì họ đã nghe những lời từ miệng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi vua trên đất sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì họ đã nghe những lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi vua trên thế giới sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sau khi nghe những lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 땅의 모든 왕들이 주님께 감사드릴 것입니다. 그들이 주님의 입의 말씀들을 들었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 땅의 모든 왕이 주님께 감사드릴 것입니다. 주님께서 하신 말씀을 들었기 때문입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 세상의 모든 왕이 주님께서 하신 말씀을 듣고 주님께 감사드릴 것입니다.

decisions.choice: they will give thanks: a confident hope
alternatives: may all the kings give you thanks
decisions.reason: The verb can be read as "they will" or as a wish, "may they". The kings hear of what God has said and done for the singer (verses 2-3), and turn to praise him (102:16; 72:11).

decisions.choice: the words of your mouth: what you have said
decisions.reason: The words God has spoken, his promise kept (verse 2).

source.text: וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י גָ֝ד֗וֹל כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will sing in [the] ways of YHWH, for great [is the] glory of YHWH.

en.L: And they will sing of the ways of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for great [is] the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: They will sing of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s ways, because the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is so great.
en.R: They will sing about the way {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} acts, because the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is so great.

fr.L: Et ils chanteront les chemins {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car grande [est] la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ils chanteront les chemins {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est si grande.
fr.R: Ils chanteront la façon dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} agit, parce que la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est si grande.

sw.L: Nao wataziimba njia za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mkuu.
sw.B: Wataziimba njia za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu mno.
sw.R: Wataimba juu ya jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anavyotenda, kwa sababu utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu mno.

es.L: Y cantarán de los caminos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque grande [es] la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Cantarán de los caminos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es muy grande.
es.R: Cantarán sobre la manera en que actúa {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es muy grande.

vi.L: Và họ sẽ ca hát về các đường lối của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [thật] lớn lao.
vi.B: Họ sẽ ca hát về đường lối của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật lớn lao.
vi.R: Họ sẽ ca hát về những việc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm, vì vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật lớn lao.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 길들을 노래할 것이니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 크기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 행하신 길을 노래할 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 참으로 크기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 일하시는 방식을 노래할 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 참으로 크기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: the ways of the LORD: how he acts
alternatives: they will sing as they walk in the ways of the LORD
decisions.reason: The "ways" of the LORD are what he does and how he deals with people (103:7). The Hebrew "sing in" may be "sing about" or "sing while walking in"; the first suits the kings who have heard his words.

decisions.choice: glory: the LORD's weight and splendor
decisions.reason: Glory (kavod) is the weight and splendor of the LORD as he shows himself (19:2; 24:7-10).

decisions.choice: 합쇼체 is kept in verses 5-6 and 8 although the LORD is named in the third person
decisions.reason: The verses stand inside a prayer that speaks to God before and after them (verses 4 and 7); changing style for a line would break the prayer, so Korean keeps the polite style and simply names the LORD.

source.text: כִּי־רָ֣ם יְ֭הוָה וְשָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: For high [is] YHWH, and the lowly he sees, and the proud from afar he knows.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] high, yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sees the lowly; and the proud {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} knows from afar.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is high, yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} looks upon those who are low; the proud {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} knows from a distance.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is high above everything, yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cares for humble people. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps proud people at a distance and knows all about them from far away.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] élevé, et pourtant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voit l’humble ; et l’orgueilleux, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le connaît de loin.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est élevé, et pourtant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} regarde les humbles ; les orgueilleux, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les connaît de loin.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est au-dessus de tout, et pourtant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend soin des gens humbles. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} tient les orgueilleux à distance, et de loin {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sait tout d’eux.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [yuko] juu, lakini huwaona wanyonge; na wenye kiburi huwajua kwa mbali.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko juu, lakini huwaangalia walio chini; wenye kiburi huwajua akiwa mbali.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko juu ya vitu vyote, lakini anawajali watu wanyenyekevu. Lakini watu wenye kiburi anawaweka mbali, na anawajua kabisa akiwa mbali.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] excelso, y sin embargo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ve al humilde; y al soberbio {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo conoce desde lejos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está en lo alto, y sin embargo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mira a los humildes; a los orgullosos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los conoce desde lejos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está por encima de todo, y sin embargo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cuida a la gente humilde. Pero a la gente orgullosa {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la mantiene a distancia y sabe todo de ella desde lejos.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [thì] cao, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đoái xem người thấp hèn; còn kẻ kiêu ngạo, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết từ xa.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật cao cả, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn đoái nhìn những người thấp hèn; còn kẻ kiêu ngạo, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết chúng từ đằng xa.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cao hơn mọi sự, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn chăm sóc những người khiêm nhường. Còn những kẻ kiêu ngạo, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ chúng ở xa và biết rõ mọi điều về chúng từ đằng xa.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 높으시나 낮은 자를 보시고, 교만한 자는 멀리서 아십니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 높이 계시지만 낮은 사람들을 굽어보시고, 교만한 사람은 멀리서도 알아보십니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 것 위에 높이 계시지만, 겸손한 사람들을 돌보아 주십니다. 그러나 교만한 사람들은 멀리 두시고, 멀리서도 그들을 다 아십니다.

decisions.choice: the high God sees the lowly
decisions.reason: The LORD is exalted above all, yet he pays attention to those who are humble and humbled (113:5-7; Isaiah 57:15).

decisions.choice: the proud he knows from afar: he sees them but keeps them far off
alternatives: even from far away he sees through the proud
decisions.reason: "From afar" may say that God keeps the proud at a distance, while he comes near the lowly, or that nothing about them escapes him even from far away. Both fit the contrast.

decisions.choice: cares for
decisions.reason: When God sees the lowly he notices and helps them (m1); Readable says so.

decisions.choice: keeps proud people at a distance
decisions.reason: Readable says both things the words of m2 imply.

source.text: אִם־אֵלֵ֤ךְ׀בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַיתִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וְת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: If I walk in [the] midst of trouble, you preserve me alive; against [the] anger of my enemies you stretch out your hand, and your right hand saves me.

en.L: If I walk in the midst of trouble, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep me alive; against the anger of my enemies {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} stretch out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand saves me.
en.B: Even when I walk through the middle of trouble, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep me alive. You reach out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand against my enemies' fury, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand rescues me.
en.R: Even when trouble is all around me, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep me alive. You reach out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand to stop my angry enemies. Your powerful right hand saves me.

fr.L: Si je marche au milieu de la détresse, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fais vivre ; contre la colère de mes ennemis {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} étends {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main, et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite me sauve.
fr.B: Même quand je marche au milieu de la détresse, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me gardes en vie. Tu étends {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main contre la fureur de mes ennemis, et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite me délivre.
fr.R: Même quand le malheur est tout autour de moi, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me gardes en vie. Tu tends {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main pour arrêter mes ennemis en colère. Ta main droite puissante me sauve.

sw.L: Nikitembea katikati ya taabu, unanihifadhi hai; dhidi ya hasira ya adui zangu unanyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume unaniokoa.
sw.B: Hata ninapopita katikati ya taabu, unanilinda niwe hai. Unanyoosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} dhidi ya ghadhabu ya adui zangu, na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kulia unaniokoa.
sw.R: Hata taabu zikinizunguka pande zote, unanilinda niwe hai. Unanyoosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kuwazuia adui zangu wenye hasira. Mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kulia wenye nguvu unaniokoa.

es.L: Si ando en medio de la angustia, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me das vida; contra la ira de mis enemigos {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} extiendes {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} diestra me salva.
es.B: Aunque camine en medio de la angustia, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me mantienes con vida. Extiendes {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano contra la furia de mis enemigos, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha me rescata.
es.R: Aunque esté rodeado de problemas, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me mantienes con vida. Extiendes {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano para detener a mis enemigos furiosos. Tu mano derecha poderosa me salva.

vi.L: Nếu tôi bước đi giữa cảnh khốn khó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ tôi sống; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra chống lại cơn giận của kẻ thù tôi, và tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu tôi.
vi.B: Dù khi tôi bước đi giữa hoạn nạn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn gìn giữ mạng sống tôi. Ngài đưa tay ra chống lại cơn thịnh nộ của kẻ thù tôi, và tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu tôi.
vi.R: Ngay cả khi khó khăn vây quanh tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn giữ cho tôi sống. Ngài đưa tay ra ngăn những kẻ thù đang giận dữ của tôi. Tay phải đầy quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu tôi.

ko.L: 제가 고난 한가운데를 걸어도 주님께서 저를 살리시고, 제 원수들의 분노를 향해 주님의 손을 뻗치시니, 주님의 오른손이 저를 구원합니다.
ko.B: 제가 고난 한복판을 지날 때에도 주님께서는 저를 살려 주십니다. 주님께서 손을 뻗어 제 원수들의 분노를 막으시고, 주님의 오른손이 저를 건져 주십니다.
ko.R: 어려움이 저를 에워쌀 때에도 주님께서는 저를 살려 주십니다. 손을 뻗어 화가 난 제 원수들을 막아 주십니다. 주님의 힘센 오른손이 저를 구해 주십니다.

decisions.choice: preserve me alive: keep me alive
decisions.reason: The verb (chayah, intensive) means to keep alive or to bring back to life; here, to keep the singer alive in danger.

decisions.choice: your right hand: your power
decisions.reason: The right hand, the stronger hand, is a picture of God's power to save (20:7; 118:15-16).

decisions.choice: powerful
decisions.reason: Readable says what the right hand stands for (m2).

source.text: יְהוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֪ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּֽרֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH will complete [it] for me; YHWH, your loyal love [is] forever; [the] works of your hands do not abandon.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will complete [it] for me; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love [is] forever; do not let go of the works of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will carry out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} plan for me. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love lasts forever; do not let go of what {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands have made.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will do everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has planned for me. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love lasts forever. Do not walk away from what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} achèvera [tout] pour moi ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours ; n’abandonne pas les œuvres de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mènera à bien {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} projet pour moi. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle dure toujours ; n’abandonne pas ce que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains ont fait.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prévu pour moi. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle dure toujours. Ne laisse pas tomber ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakamilisha [hilo] kwa ajili yangu; Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele; usiziache kazi za mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atalitimiza kusudi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwangu. Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unadumu milele; usiyaache uliyoyaumba kwa mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atafanya kila kitu ambacho amenipangia. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unadumu milele. Usiyaache uliyoyafanya.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} completará [su obra] por mí; {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal [es] para siempre; no sueltes las obras de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llevará a cabo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} plan para mí. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel dura para siempre; no sueltes lo que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos han hecho.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha planeado para mí. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel dura para siempre. No abandones lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ hoàn thành [điều đó] cho tôi; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [còn] đến đời đời; xin đừng buông bỏ công việc của tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ thực hiện kế hoạch {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} định cho tôi. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời; xin đừng buông bỏ những gì tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm trọn mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định cho tôi. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời. Xin đừng bỏ đi khỏi những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tạo nên.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 저를 위하여 [그 일을] 이루실 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 한결같은 사랑은 영원합니다. 주님의 손으로 지으신 것들을 놓지 마십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 저를 향한 그분의 계획을 이루실 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 한결같은 사랑은 영원합니다. 주님의 손으로 만드신 것을 놓지 마십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 저를 위해 계획하신 일을 모두 이루실 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 변함없는 사랑은 영원합니다. 주님께서 만드신 것을 버리고 떠나지 마십시오.

decisions.choice: will complete for me: will carry his purpose through
decisions.reason: As in 57:3, the verb (gamar) means to bring to an end or complete: God finishes what he has begun for his servant.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here the LORD's love for his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: the works of your hands: what God has made and begun
alternatives: the singer himself, made by God
decisions.reason: The singer may mean himself, as one God has made (139:13-16; Job 10:3, 8), or all that God has begun to do for him. Either way he asks God to finish it.

decisions.choice: his plan (B); everything he has planned (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the object the verb implies, as in 57:3 (m1).

decisions.choice: do not let go of (L, B); do not walk away from (R)
decisions.reason: The verb (rafah, causative) is to let drop or let go, a picture of a hand releasing its hold.
